ukkaḍḍhati.p: [U+kaḍḍha+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) Postpone or delay. (A) Causes to increase. Reaches the first month of Hemanta but does not make the First month of Hemanta and makes the fourth month of vassana for the next time. Intercalate a month ( the second (month) of the fourth month of vassana). (B) Postpone. (2) Postpone. Blocks for donation.  See also - Ukkaḍḍhitukāma, ukkaḍḍhiyati.
a: ဥက္ကဍ္ဎတိ(ကြိ)

(၁)အထက်သို့ ဆွဲငင်၏။(က)တိုးပွါးစေ၏၊ ဝါခေါင်လကို ဝါခေါင်လ မပြုလုပ်သေးပဲ နောက်ထပ် ဝါဆိုလတလပြုလုပ်၏၊ ဝါထပ်၏။(ခ)ရွှေ့ဆိုင်း၏။(၂)ဆွဲငင်၏။ ပေးလှူခြင်းကိစ္စ၌ ကန့်ကွက်ဟန့်တား၏။ ဥက္ကဍ္ဎိတုကာမ, ဥက္ကဍ္ဎိယတိ-တို့လည်းကြည့်။

ukkaḍḍhitukāma.p: [Ukkaḍḍhituṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 Postponed (want to make fall to the first month of Hemanta but does not make the First month of Hemanta and makes the fourth month of vassana for the next time).

ukkaḍḍhiyyati.p: [U+kaḍḍha+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Should be postponed. Should be caused to increase.  (Should make intercalate a month ( the second (month) of the fourth month of vassana).
